name: Nyar'zathul, the Crawling Dream
ability: This unit is also a nexus token. If it is removed using INCOMPREHENSIBLE FORM, produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponents' ships.

name: The Recurring
ability: When this unit would be destroyed, you may spend 1 influence to place it on another planet in a system that contains 1 of your nexus tokens.

name: Liturgy I
ability: At the end of a tactical action in this unit's system, you may place or move 1 nexus token into this system.

name: Liturgy II
ability: At the end of a tactical action in this unit's system, you may place or move 1 nexus token into a non-home system that contains 1 or more of your ships and no other player's ships.

name: The Fractal
ability: After this unit is destroyed, you may return a number of captured fighters from your faction sheet up to the capacity value of this unit to place 1 ship in this system with a cost of no more than the amount of fighters returned.

name: Refractum
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of ground combat, you may return 2 captured fighters to place 1 mech from your reinforcements on that planet.

name: Shard Swarm
ability: This unit may move without being transported. Fighters in excess of  your capacity count against your fleet limit. When this unit is destroyed, it captures itself. At the start of your turn, you may place up to 2 fighters from your reinforcements in any system that contains a planet you control.

name: The Pyre
ability: For each infantry destroyed by this unit's BOMBARDMENT ability, commit 1 captured infantry from your faction sheet to that planet.

name: Balefire Sentinel
ability: When this unit would be destroyed, place it on this card. At the start of your next turn place each unit on this card on planets you control in your home system.

name: Ashfall Engine I
ability: During combat, when this unit would be destroyed, you may use its BOMBARDMENT ability against a planet in its system.

name: Ashfall Engine II
ability:
This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards.

During combat, when this unit would be destroyed or uses its SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability, you may use its BOMBARDMENT ability against a planet in its system.

name: Cinderborn II
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of a round of ground combat on a planet you control, you may place 1 captured infantry on that planet.

name: Iron Dominion
ability: Your mechs in the space area of this system gain Anti-Fighter Barrage 7(x2).

name: Riptide I
ability: When this unit is destroyed, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on its planet. If it was in the space area, place 1 fighter instead.

name: Riptide II
ability: When this unit is destroyed, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on its planet. If it was in the space area, place 1 fighter instead. This unit may move without being transported. Mechs in excess of capacity count against your fleet limit.

name: Worldshaper
ability: 1 planet of your choice in this system you control has its resource and influence values increased by 1, and 1 planet of your choice in this system controlled by another player has its resource and influence values reduced by 1.

name: Valuator
ability: DEPLOY: When you attach a card to a planet, you may spend 1 resource to place a mech on that planet.

name: Trojan
ability: After this unit moves, before SPACE CANNON OFFENSE, choose 1 unit ability other than SUSTAIN DAMAGE. All units in this unit's system lose that ability until the end of this action.

name: Legion
ability: DEPLOY: When you gain a technology, you may place a mech from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: The Chained
ability: Other player's units in this system lose their unit abilities while this unit is not damaged.

name: Penitent
ability: This unit gains +1 to its combat rolls for each exhausted doctrine in your play area.
